purpose: Select exactly one economically independent offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign092, before opening any Campaign093 minute source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price, or forward return.

finite_candidate_design_catalog.reason: It compares quadratic variation in adjacent continuous-session closes with contemporaneous destination-bar high-low quadratic variation on exactly the same 238 within-half opportunities. This targets close-to-close price discovery relative to intrabar excursion noise, not an open gap, candle body, five-minute aggregation, bipower jump estimator, raw volatility level, or range-clock statistic.

Using absolute first powers would be too close to Campaign092's linear gap-versus-range allocation and would introduce a transform choice. Campaign093 freezes the conventional quadratic-variation scale only.
A signed numerator would reopen terminal signed-path, direction, and body-pressure families. Campaign093 freezes a nonnegative variation-allocation mechanism.
Open gaps, bodies, wicks, activity weights, and market residuals are already represented by terminal mechanisms and would create a field or weighting search.
Subwindows, thresholds, filters, regimes, fitting, ranks, neutralization, and models are outside the one-factor finite catalog.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_close_transition_range_quadratic_efficiency_238p
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A larger share of completed-session quadratic price variation appearing in successive closing levels rather than temporary intrabar high-low excursions indicates more durable information incorporation that may continue from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: Within each 120-bar half, for j=1..119 set c_j=ln(close_j/close_j-1) and h_j=ln(high_j/low_j) on the same destination bar. Pool 238 pairs, let Q=sum(c_j^2), H=sum(h_j^2), and return Q/(Q+H).
selected_candidate.source_grid: Require the raw 09:30 row for immutable source identity; use exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, exclude 09:30, and reset both return vectors at lunch.
selected_candidate.support: Require every selected high, low, and close to be finite and strictly positive with low<=close<=high, retain exact-zero transitions and ranges, and require finite strictly positive Q+H over all 238 pairs.
